name: liftoff/card
title: Card
description: Themed surface container styled entirely with semantic tokens.

files.content:
---
/**
 * @title Card
 * @level liftoff
 * @description Themed surface container styled entirely with semantic tokens.
 * @category Layout
 * @hydration none
 * @accessibility
 * - Renders a plain `<section>`; consumers supply headings and landmarks.
 * @keyboard
 * - No custom keyboard behavior.
 * @slots
 * - `default`: Card content.
 */

import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";
import "./core.css";

type Props = HTMLAttributes<"section">;

---

<section data-lsui-card {...Astro.props}>
  <slot />
</section>
